diff --git a/logscan.py b/logscan.py
index 467d0e0..49925ca 100644
--- a/logscan.py
+++ b/logscan.py
@@ -11,10 +11,16 @@ def line_level(line):
 
 
 def filter_lines(lines, level):
+    """Return lines at `level` or more serious. Lines with no recognized level are skipped."""
     level = level.upper()
     if level not in LEVELS:
         raise ValueError(f"unknown level {level}")
-    return [line for line in lines if line_level(line) == level]
+    minimum = LEVELS.index(level)
+    return [
+        line
+        for line in lines
+        if line_level(line) is not None and LEVELS.index(line_level(line)) >= minimum
+    ]
 
 
 def main(argv):

+from logscan import LEVELS, filter_lines, line_level
 
 LINES = [
     "2026-03-01 02:00:00 INFO nightly sync started",
@@ -8,14 +8,45 @@ LINES = [

+ALL_LEVELS = [
+    "2026-03-01 03:00:00 DEBUG probing",

+    "2026-03-01 03:00:04 CRITICAL out of memory",
+]
+
 
 def test_line_level():
     assert line_level(LINES[1]) == "WARNING"
     assert line_level("no level here") is None
 
 
-def test_top_level_only_matches_itself():
+def test_error_includes_more_serious():
     assert filter_lines(LINES, "ERROR") == [LINES[2]]
+    assert filter_lines(ALL_LEVELS, "ERROR") == ALL_LEVELS[3:]
+
+
+def test_warning_returns_warning_error_critical():
+    assert filter_lines(ALL_LEVELS, "WARNING") == ALL_LEVELS[2:]
+

+def test_critical_returns_only_critical():
